item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The World Bank described an economic-governance reform operation supporting the Congolese government’s reform program and a Girls’ Learning and Empowerment Project supporting secondary-school quality, access, girls’ retention, and safer, more inclusive schools free from sexual exploitation and abuse; both projects were financed by IDA.","notes":["The excerpt does not state the 29 March 2023 approval date or the $500 million and $400 million amounts."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"UNESCO regretted that the State Party had not submitted the implementation report requested by the Committee at its 44th extended session and noted reports of alleged human-rights abuses against Indigenous peoples and local communities during law-enforcement operations; it requested a national eco-guard code of conduct, a grievance mechanism, human-rights training, and rights-based involvement of affected communities.","notes":["The excerpt supports the prior-session reference to 2021 but does not explicitly state that the decision itself was adopted in 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"UNESCO reported improved security in Salonga, Kahuzi-Biega, and Garamba National Parks, continued security challenges in Okapi Wildlife Reserve, and heavy fighting since 2022 in Virunga National Park, partly controlled by rebel groups, where park staff had been killed; it urged the State Party to strengthen ICCN capacity and take measures to restore peace and security.","notes":["The excerpt supports the 2022 conflict reference but does not explicitly state that the decision is from 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
